'''Hargon's Hill''' was a low peak located on [[Garos IV]]. Just south of [[Ariana]], a [[Hibridium/Legends|hibridium]] vein was found in the hill and exhausted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Journal" />
